execution.stateResetPolicy: Reset all state before each paid round
execution.sessionPolicy: Fixed horizon; ruin is first inability to fund the next wager. Play continues with hypothetical credit; no survivor-only RTP denominator. Session money uses exact shortest round-trip decimals without currency rounding; report values are binary64.
